name: elkpd-pdf-import-spike
description: Spike for issue #2: turn an arbitrary worksheet PDF into an editable ELKPD-ify scaffold (findings: docs/pdf-import-spike.md)

scripts.demo: node make-demo-pdf.mjs out/demo-worksheet.pdf && node extract.mjs out/demo-worksheet.pdf out/demo && node compare.mjs out/demo-worksheet.pdf out/demo/scaffold.html out/demo-compare --scale 1.5
scripts.lkpd: node extract.mjs "../../reference/LKPD Teks Cerpen SMA Kelas XI (1).pdf" out/lkpd && node compare.mjs "../../reference/LKPD Teks Cerpen SMA Kelas XI (1).pdf" out/lkpd/scaffold.html out/lkpd-compare --scale 1.5
